# MECHANISM (EXPLORATORY)

# 14. H5 — Trust subscale profile (MANOVA + profile-distance score)

> **H5 (exploratory).** The pattern of AI-label effects across competence, predictability, and benevolence discriminates between **algorithm aversion** (uniformly low), **reactance** (high competence, low benevolence), and **strategic exploitation** (flat profile). MANOVA tests whether profile *shape* differs by condition. The Mahalanobis profile-distance score (§14b) gives a quantitative answer to which mechanism the observed AI-vs-Human profile most closely resembles.

## 14a. MANOVA on the three subscales

```{r manova}
trustVec <- as.matrix(data %>% select(competence, benevolence, predictability))
modMANOVA <- manova(trustVec ~ Label * Transparency, data = data)
print(summary(modMANOVA, test = "Pillai"))
print(summary.aov(modMANOVA))
```

```{r manova-profile, fig.height = 5}
profileDF <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(c(competence, benevolence, predictability),
               names_to = "Subscale", values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(Subscale = factor(Subscale,
           levels = c("competence","benevolence","predictability"),
           labels = c("Competence","Benevolence","Predictability"))) %>%
  group_by(Label, Transparency, Subscale) %>%
  summarise(M = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
            SE = sd(Score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Cell = factor(paste(Label, Transparency, sep = "—"),
                       levels = c("Human—Opaque","Human—Transparent",
                                  "AI—Opaque","AI—Transparent")))

ggplot(profileDF, aes(Subscale, M, colour = Cell, group = Cell)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = M - SE, ymax = M + SE),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid","longdash","solid","longdash"),
                        guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(palette4)) +
  labs(x = "Trust subscale", y = "Mean rating (1–5)", colour = "Condition",
       title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)

figText(
  "Trust subscale profiles by condition",
  "Mean competence, benevolence, and predictability across the four cells")
```

## 14b. Profile-distance score (which mechanism does the observed AI profile resemble?)

We z-score the *AI − Human* difference vector across the three subscales and compute its Mahalanobis distance to each theoretically predicted profile. Smaller distance = closer match. 

```{r profile-distance}
# Observed AI - Human difference vector on the three subscales, z-scored
zScale <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))
diffObs <- data %>%
  mutate(across(c(competence, benevolence, predictability), zScale)) %>%
  group_by(Label) %>%
  summarise(competence = mean(competence, na.rm = TRUE),
            benevolence = mean(benevolence, na.rm = TRUE),
            predictability = mean(predictability, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Label, names_to = "subscale", values_to = "zMean") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Label, values_from = zMean) %>%
  mutate(diff = AI - Human)

# Theoretical mechanism profiles (pre-registered)
mechanisms <- cfg$mechanism_profiles

obsVec  <- diffObs$diff[match(c("competence","benevolence","predictability"),
                              diffObs$subscale)]
covMat  <- cov(data %>% select(competence, benevolence, predictability),
               use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
covMatZ <- cov2cor(covMat)   # z-scored covariance matrix for Mahalanobis distance
profileTab <- mechanisms %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(d_Mahalanobis = sqrt(t(c(competence, benevolence, predictability) - obsVec) %*%
                              solve(covMatZ) %*%
                              (c(competence, benevolence, predictability) - obsVec))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(d_Mahalanobis) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())

knitr::kable(roundDF(profileTab, 3),
             caption = "Table 19. Mahalanobis distance from observed AI − Human profile to predicted mechanism profiles (smaller = better fit)")
```

# 15. Mediation — Model 4 (full vs partial)

X = `labelContrast` (AI = 1, Human = 0) → M = `trustMayer` → Y = `openingDemand`. Both models adjust for Transparency, suspicion.

> **Temporal caveat.** The Mayer composite is captured post-survey, so this estimates a cross-sectional indirect effect; the design does not establish temporal precedence of trust over the opening demand. §15c reports a sensitivity using the in-chat `finalTrustChat` rating as an alternative trust measure.

## 15a. Full vs partial mediation

```{r med-fits}
# Covariates: keep only those present and populated (>10 non-NA).
medCovs <- intersect(c("suspicion","offScriptPct"),
                     names(data)[colSums(!is.na(data)) > 10])
medData <- data %>%
  select(labelContrast, transContrast, trustMayer, openingDemand,
         all_of(medCovs)) %>%
  drop_na()
covRHS <- if (length(medCovs)) paste("+", paste(medCovs, collapse = " + ")) else ""

# Full mediation: label acts on demand only through trust (no direct path).
medFull <- sprintf('
  trustMayer    ~ a*labelContrast + transContrast %s
  openingDemand ~ b*trustMayer + transContrast %s
  indirect := a*b
', covRHS, covRHS)

# Partial mediation: adds the direct label -> demand path (cprime); saturated (0 df).
medPartial <- sprintf('
  trustMayer    ~ a*labelContrast + transContrast %s
  openingDemand ~ b*trustMayer + cprime*labelContrast + transContrast %s
  indirect := a*b
  total    := cprime + indirect
', covRHS, covRHS)

set.seed(cfg$seed)
fitFull    <- sem(medFull,    data = medData,
                  se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = cfg$bootstrap_reps,
                  parallel = "snow", ncpus = nCores)
fitPartial <- sem(medPartial, data = medData,
                  se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = cfg$bootstrap_reps,
                  parallel = "snow", ncpus = nCores)

# Report the full model; the partial model is saturated, so its fit indices are trivial.
summary(fitFull, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

# Likelihood-ratio test for the direct label -> demand path. The test statistic
# sits on the constrained model's row.
cmp <- lavaan::anova(fitPartial, fitFull)
print(cmp)

pCmp <- cmp[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2]

# AIC/BIC from each fit; lower is better. Labelled by structure so the direction is clear.
fmFull    <- fitMeasures(fitFull,    c("aic","bic"))
fmPartial <- fitMeasures(fitPartial, c("aic","bic"))
winAIC <- if (fmFull["aic"] < fmPartial["aic"]) "full (no direct path)" else "partial (direct path)"
winBIC <- if (fmFull["bic"] < fmPartial["bic"]) "full (no direct path)" else "partial (direct path)"

# Verdict from the LRT, with whether AIC and BIC agree checked against the values.
dropWins <- winAIC == "full (no direct path)" && winBIC == "full (no direct path)"
verdict <- if (pCmp >= .05) {
  paste0("Direct path adds nothing (LRT p = ", formatP(pCmp),
         "); full mediation retained. ",
         if (dropWins) "AIC and BIC concur." else "Note: AIC/BIC do not both agree (see values above).")
} else {
  paste0("Direct path improves fit (LRT p = ", formatP(pCmp),
         "); retain the model with the direct path. ",
         if (!dropWins) "AIC and BIC concur." else "Note: AIC/BIC do not both agree (see values above).")
}

cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "\nMediation model comparison (direct label -> demand path)\n",
  "  LRT: Delta chi-sq(1) = %.2f, p = %s\n",
  "  AIC favours: %s\n",
  "  BIC favours: %s\n",
  "  Verdict: %s\n"),
  cmp[["Chisq diff"]][2], formatP(pCmp), winAIC, winBIC, verdict))
```

## 15b. Mediation diagram

```{r med-diagram, fig.height = 5}
# Mediation path diagram: X to M to Y, with a and b paths, dashed c', and the indirect effect.
library(grid)

betasP <- standardizedSolution(fitPartial)
gv <- function(lab) betasP[betasP$label == lab, ]
aP <- gv("a"); bP <- gv("b"); cP <- gv("cprime"); iP <- gv("indirect")
z0 <- function(x) ifelse(abs(x) < 0.005, 0, x)
a_lab <- sprintf("a = %.2f%s", z0(aP$est.std), sigStars(aP$pvalue))
b_lab <- sprintf("b = %.2f%s", z0(bP$est.std), sigStars(bP$pvalue))
c_lab <- sprintf("c' = %.2f%s", z0(cP$est.std), sigStars(cP$pvalue))
i_lab <- sprintf("indirect \u03b2 = %.2f%s  \u00b7  95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]",
                 z0(iP$est.std), sigStars(iP$pvalue), iP$ci.lower, iP$ci.upper)
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(xscale = c(0, 620), yscale = c(0, 300)))
yShift <- -28
X <- function(x) unit(x/620, "npc"); Y <- function(y) unit((300-(y+yShift))/300, "npc")
# helper: quadratic Bezier as a polyline between (x0,y0)-(x1,y1) with control (cx,cy)
bez <- function(x0,y0,cx,cy,x1,y1,col,lwd=1.6,dash=FALSE,arrow=TRUE){
  t <- seq(0,1,length.out=60)
  bx <- (1-t)^2*x0 + 2*(1-t)*t*cx + t^2*x1
  by <- (1-t)^2*y0 + 2*(1-t)*t*cy + t^2*y1
  grid.lines(x = X(bx), y = Y(by),
             gp = gpar(col=col, lwd=lwd, lty=if(dash) "22" else "solid"),
             arrow = if(arrow) arrow(angle=22, length=unit(0.16,"cm"), type="closed") else NULL)
}
txt <- function(x,y,lab,size,col,face="plain",italic=FALSE)
  grid.text(lab, X(x), Y(y),
            gp=gpar(fontsize=size, col=col, fontface=if(italic) "italic" else face))
pill <- function(x,y,w,fill){
  grid.roundrect(X(x), Y(y), width=unit(w/620,"npc"), height=unit(24/300,"npc"),
                 r=unit(0.4,"snpc"), gp=gpar(fill=fill, col=NA))
}
pathCol <- "#34495E"; greyCol <- "#7F8C8D"
# curved a, b, c' paths
bez(150,195, 200,135, 275,108, pathCol)
bez(345,108, 420,135, 470,195, pathCol)
bez(165,235, 310,285, 455,235, greyCol, lwd=1.3, dash=TRUE)
# nodes
txt(310,84,"Trust (M)",13,"#185FA5","bold")
txt(310,100,"Mayer composite",9,greyCol)
txt(130,212,"AI label (X)",12,"#2C3E50","bold")
txt(130,228,"1 = AI, 0 = Human",8.5,greyCol)
txt(500,212,"Opening demand (Y)",12,"#2C3E50","bold")
txt(500,228,"Opening equity %",8.5,greyCol)
# coefficient pills + labels
pill(198,140,92,"#EAF1F8"); txt(198,140,a_lab,10,"#185FA5","bold")
pill(424,140,96,"#EAF1F8"); txt(424,140,b_lab,10,"#185FA5","bold")
pill(310,280,108,"#F1EFE8"); txt(310,282,c_lab,9.5,greyCol)
# indirect effect
txt(310,178,i_lab,11,"#BA7517","bold")
popViewport()
figText(
  "Mediation of the AI-label effect on opening demand through trust",
  "Standardised coefficients; paths marked * significant at p < .05, ns otherwise")
```

## 15c. Sensitivity — `finalTrustChat` (in-chat) as M

An alternative trust measure, the in-chat rating collected during the negotiation. Reported as a sensitivity.

```{r med-chattrust}
if (sum(!is.na(data$finalTrustChat)) > cfg$med_min_nonNA) {
  medChat <- data %>%
    select(labelContrast, transContrast, finalTrustChat, openingDemand,
           all_of(medCovs)) %>%
    drop_na()

  modChat <- sprintf('
    finalTrustChat ~ a*labelContrast + transContrast %s
    openingDemand  ~ b*finalTrustChat + cprime*labelContrast + transContrast %s
    indirect := a*b
  ', covRHS, covRHS)

  set.seed(cfg$seed)
  fitChat <- sem(modChat, data = medChat,
                 se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = cfg$bootstrap_reps,
                 parallel = "snow", ncpus = nCores)
  print(parameterEstimates(fitChat) %>%
        filter(label %in% c("a","b","cprime","indirect")) %>%
        select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper, pvalue) %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))))
} else {
  cat("Sensitivity skipped — finalTrustChat has insufficient non-missing values.\n")
}
```

## 15d. Round-by-round indirect effects

```{r round-mediation, fig.height = 5}
runMedRound <- function(rNum) {
  yvar <- paste0("demandR", rNum)
  d <- data %>% select(labelContrast, transContrast, trustMayer,
                       all_of(medCovs), all_of(yvar)) %>% drop_na()
  if (nrow(d) < cfg$med_min_nonNA) return(tibble(round = rNum, est = NA, lwr = NA,
                                  upr = NA, p = NA))
  names(d)[ncol(d)] <- "Y"
  m <- sprintf('
    trustMayer ~ a*labelContrast + transContrast %s
    Y ~ b*trustMayer + cprime*labelContrast + transContrast %s
    indirect := a*b
  ', covRHS, covRHS)
  set.seed(cfg$seed + rNum)
  fit <- sem(m, data = d, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = cfg$bootstrap_reps,
             parallel = "snow", ncpus = nCores)
  ind <- standardizedSolution(fit) %>% filter(label == "indirect")
  tibble(round = rNum,
         est = ind$est.std, lwr = ind$ci.lower, upr = ind$ci.upper, p = ind$pvalue)
}

roundMedTab <- map_dfr(seq_len(cfg$n_rounds), runMedRound)
knitr::kable(roundDF(roundMedTab, 3),
             caption = "Table 20. Round-by-round indirect effects (standardised)")

ggplot(roundMedTab %>% drop_na(), aes(round, est)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = subtleCol, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = hlCol, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(colour = hlCol, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 18, colour = hlCol) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(cfg$n_rounds)) +
  labs(x = "Negotiation round", y = "Indirect effect (β, standardised)",
       title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)

figText(
  "Indirect effect of Label on demand through trust, by round",
  "Standardised indirect effect across negotiation rounds")
```

# 16. Moderated mediation — Model 7 (trust propensity moderates a-path)

```{r mod-med}
medData2 <- data %>%
  mutate(trustPropC = as.numeric(scale(trustPropensity, scale = FALSE))) %>%
  select(labelContrast, transContrast, trustMayer, openingDemand, trustPropC,
         all_of(medCovs)) %>%
  drop_na()

med7 <- sprintf('
  trustMayer  ~ a1*labelContrast + a2*trustPropC + a3*labelContrast:trustPropC + transContrast %s
  openingDemand ~ b*trustMayer + cprime*labelContrast + transContrast %s
  indirectLow  := (a1 + a3 * (-1)) * b
  indirectMean := a1 * b
  indirectHigh := (a1 + a3 *  1) * b
  indexModMed  := a3 * b
', covRHS, covRHS)

set.seed(cfg$seed)
fit7 <- sem(med7, data = medData2,
            se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = cfg$bootstrap_reps,
            parallel = "snow", ncpus = nCores)
summary(fit7, standardized = TRUE, ci = TRUE)

condEff <- parameterEstimates(fit7) %>%
  filter(label %in% c("indirectLow","indirectMean","indirectHigh","indexModMed")) %>%
  select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper, pvalue) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))
knitr::kable(condEff,
             caption = "Table 21. Conditional indirect effects + index of moderated mediation")
```

```{r mod-med-plot, fig.height = 4.5}
condDF <- condEff %>%
  filter(label %in% c("indirectLow","indirectMean","indirectHigh")) %>%
  mutate(level = factor(label,
                        levels = c("indirectLow","indirectMean","indirectHigh"),
                        labels = c("Low (−1 SD)","Mean","High (+1 SD)")))

ggplot(condDF, aes(level, est)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = subtleCol, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci.lower, ymax = ci.upper),
                width = 0.10, linewidth = 0.6, colour = pathCol) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 18, colour = hlCol) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.04)) +
 labs(x = "Trust propensity",
       y = "Conditional indirect effect\n(Label → Trust → Demand)",
       title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
        plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 20))

idxMM <- condEff[condEff$label == "indexModMed", ]
figText(
  "Conditional indirect effects of Label on demand through trust, by trust propensity",
  "Standardised indirect effect at low, mean, and high trust propensity")
```

# ROBUSTNESS

# 17. Bayesian replication of H1, H3, H2a, and H4

Bayes Factors are paired with frequentist tests. BF₁₀ > 10 = strong evidence for the alternative; BF₀₁ > 10 = strong evidence for the null. Particularly informative if H3 returns null — distinguishes evidence-of-absence from absence-of-evidence.

```{r bayesian}
data$agreedNum <- as.numeric(data$agreed)

bfData_trust <- data %>% filter(!is.na(trustMayer),    !is.na(Label), !is.na(Transparency))
bfData_open  <- data %>% filter(!is.na(openingDemand), !is.na(Label), !is.na(Transparency))
bfData_conc  <- data %>% filter(!is.na(concession),    !is.na(Label), !is.na(Transparency))
bfData_agree <- data %>% filter(!is.na(agreedNum),     !is.na(Label), !is.na(Transparency))

cat(sprintf("BF samples — Trust: %d | Opening demand: %d | Concession: %d | Agreement: %d\n",
            nrow(bfData_trust), nrow(bfData_open), nrow(bfData_conc), nrow(bfData_agree)))

bfTrust <- BayesFactor::anovaBF(trustMayer    ~ Label * Transparency,
                                data = as.data.frame(bfData_trust), progress = FALSE)
bfOpen  <- BayesFactor::anovaBF(openingDemand ~ Label * Transparency,
                                data = as.data.frame(bfData_open),  progress = FALSE)
bfConc  <- BayesFactor::anovaBF(concession    ~ Label * Transparency,
                                data = as.data.frame(bfData_conc),  progress = FALSE)
bfAgree <- BayesFactor::anovaBF(agreedNum     ~ Label * Transparency,
                                data = as.data.frame(bfData_agree), progress = FALSE)

extractBFs <- function(bf, label) {
  s <- as.data.frame(bf) %>% rownames_to_column("model")
  tibble(Outcome = label, Model = s$model,
         BF10 = round(s$bf, 2), BF01 = round(1 / s$bf, 2))
}

bfTab <- bind_rows(
  extractBFs(bfTrust, "Trust (H1, H3 interaction)"),
  extractBFs(bfOpen,  "Opening demand (H2a)"),
  extractBFs(bfConc,  "Concession (H2b)"),
  extractBFs(bfAgree, "Agreement (H4)")
)
knitr::kable(bfTab, caption = "Table 22. Bayesian ANOVA: Bayes factors for each model against the null (BF₁₀) and the reciprocal favouring the null (BF₀₁).")
```

```{r bayes-plot, fig.height = 8}
plotBF <- bfTab %>%
  mutate(logBF = log10(BF10),
         bfLabel = ifelse(BF10 >= 1,
                          sprintf("BF = %.1f", BF10),
                          sprintf("BF = 1/%.1f", 1/BF10)))

xLim <- max(3, max(abs(plotBF$logBF), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.3)

ggplot(plotBF, aes(reorder(Model, logBF), logBF)) +

 theme(legend.position = "none",
```

# 18. Specification curve — Label effect on demand DVs

Effect of Label on demand across all defensible specifications: outcome (opening / final / concession / slope) × covariate set (none / suspicion / suspicion + offScript) × subset (full / non-suspicious / on-script). Because LLM-compliance (`offScriptPct`) was not coded for this dataset, specifications requiring it — the off-script covariate set and the on-script subset — are not estimable and drop out, leaving the estimable specifications reported below. The pre-registered specification is `outcome = openingDemand, covariates = suspicion, subset = full`.

```{r spec-curve, fig.height = 7}
outcomes <- c("openingDemand","finalDemand","concession","demandSlope")
covariateSets <- list(none = c(), suspicion = "suspicion",
                      both = c("suspicion","offScriptPct"))
subsets <- list(
  full         = function(d) d,
  noSuspicious = function(d) d %>% filter(suspicion < cfg$susp_exclusion_cutoff),
  noOffScript  = function(d) if ("offScriptPct" %in% names(d) &&
                                 sum(!is.na(d$offScriptPct)) > 0)
                              d %>% filter(offScriptPct < cfg$offscript_exclusion_cutoff)
                            else d[0, ]   #  if offScriptPct is missing, return empty data frame
)

specGrid <- expand_grid(outcome = outcomes,
                        covSet  = names(covariateSets),
                        subsetID = names(subsets)) %>%
  mutate(specID = row_number())

runSpec <- function(outcome, covSet, subsetID) {
  d <- subsets[[subsetID]](data)
  if (nrow(d) < 8) return(tibble(estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA))
  covs <- covariateSets[[covSet]]
  if (length(covs)) {
    keep <- vapply(covs, \(v) v %in% names(d) && sum(!is.na(d[[v]])) > 0, logical(1))
    covs <- covs[keep]
  }
  rhs <- paste(c("Label * Transparency", covs), collapse = " + ")
  fml <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", rhs))
  m <- tryCatch(lm(fml, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m)) return(tibble(estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA))
  aliased <- names(which(is.na(coef(m))))
  if (length(aliased)) {
    keepCovs <- setdiff(covs, aliased)
    rhs <- paste(c("Label * Transparency", keepCovs), collapse = " + ")
    fml <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", rhs))
    m <- tryCatch(lm(fml, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(m)) return(tibble(estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA))
  }
  co <- broom::tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE) %>% filter(term == "Label1")
  if (nrow(co) == 0) return(tibble(estimate = NA, conf.low = NA, conf.high = NA, p.value = NA))
  co %>% transmute(estimate = -2 * estimate,
                   conf.low = -2 * conf.high,
                   conf.high = -2 * conf.low,
                   p.value)
}

specResults <- specGrid %>%
  mutate(res = pmap(list(outcome, covSet, subsetID), runSpec)) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>%          # drop any specs that failed to converge or had aliased covariates
  arrange(estimate) %>%
  mutate(specRank = row_number(),       # rank by effect size
         sig = !is.na(p.value) & p.value < .05,
         isPrereg = outcome == "openingDemand" & covSet == "both" & subsetID == "full")

# Pre-registered specification rank (for plotting the dotted line)
preregRank <- specResults$specRank[specResults$isPrereg]
if (length(preregRank) != 1 || is.na(preregRank)) preregRank <- NA_real_

outcomeColors <- c(openingDemand = accentCol, finalDemand = hlCol,
                   concession = perfCol, demandSlope = sigCol)
outcomeLabels <- c(openingDemand = "Opening demand", finalDemand = "Final demand",
                   concession = "Concession (open - final)", demandSlope = "Demand slope")

# Top-panel y-limits from the 15th/75th percentiles of estimates and CIs; extreme CIs clipped.  
yCapHi <- as.numeric(quantile(c(specResults$conf.high, specResults$estimate), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
yCapLo <- as.numeric(quantile(c(specResults$conf.low,  specResults$estimate), 0.15, na.rm = TRUE))
yCap   <- c(min(yCapLo, -1), max(yCapHi, 1))
nClipped <- sum(specResults$conf.high > yCap[2] | specResults$conf.low < yCap[1], na.rm = TRUE)
nSig <- sum(specResults$sig, na.rm = TRUE)
nSpec <- nrow(specResults)

# TOP PANEL — coloured by outcome; faded = ns, solid = p < .05
top <- ggplot(specResults, aes(specRank, estimate)) +
  {if (!is.na(preregRank))
     geom_vline(xintercept = preregRank, colour = nullCol,
                linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8)} +
  {if (!is.na(preregRank))
     annotate("text", x = preregRank, y = yCap[2],
              label = "Pre-registered", hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4,
              size = 3, fontface = "bold", colour = nullCol)} +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = mainCol, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(conf.low, yCap[1]),
                    ymax = pmin(conf.high, yCap[2]),
                    colour = outcome, alpha = sig),
                width = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = outcome, size = sig, alpha = sig)) +
  annotate("text", x = nSpec, y = yCap[2],
           label = "faded = ns  \u00b7  solid = p < .05", hjust = 1, vjust = -1.8,
           size = 3, fontface = "italic", colour = subtleCol) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = outcomeColors, labels = outcomeLabels, name = "Outcome") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1.8, `TRUE` = 3.2), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.35, `TRUE` = 1), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, nSpec + 1), expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = yCap, clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "AI \u2212 Human effect on demand DV",
       title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin  = margin(28, 15, 5, 15))

# BOTTOM PANEL — analytic choices per spec, faceted by factor; dotted line marks the pre-registered spec.
specLong <- specResults %>%
  select(specRank, outcome, covSet, subsetID) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(outcome, covSet, subsetID), names_to = "factor", values_to = "level") %>%
  mutate(factor = factor(factor, levels = c("outcome","covSet","subsetID"),

bottom <- ggplot(specLong, aes(specRank, level)) +

  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),

top / bottom + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1.7))

figText(
```

# 19. Equivalence testing on null primaries (TOST)

Two one-sided tests against a smallest-effect-size-of-interest. SESOI = *d* = 0.30 for the H3 interaction (no clear prior), *d* = 0.40 for the H1 main effect (calibrated below the d ≈ 0.50 design target so a "no effect" conclusion is conservative).

```{r tost}
runTOST <- function(estimate, SE, df, sesoiD, sdRef, label) {
  bound <- sesoiD * sdRef
  tLow  <- (estimate - (-bound)) / SE
  tUp   <- (estimate -   bound)  / SE
  pLow  <- pt(tLow, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  pUp   <- pt(tUp,  df = df, lower.tail = TRUE)
  pTOST <- max(pLow, pUp)
  ciLow  <- estimate - qt(.95, df) * SE
  ciHigh <- estimate + qt(.95, df) * SE
  tibble(Test = label,
         SESOI_d = sesoiD, bound = round(bound, 3),
         estimate = round(estimate, 3),
         CI90_low = round(ciLow, 3), CI90_high = round(ciHigh, 3),
         p_TOST = formatP(pTOST),
         equivalence = if (pTOST < .05 && ciLow > -bound && ciHigh < bound)
                         "Supported" else "NOT supported")
}

# H3 Label × Transparency interaction on trust
intCon <- contrast(emmTrust, list(`L×T interaction` = c(1, -1, -1, 1))) %>%
            as.data.frame()
sdTrust <- sd(data$trustMayer, na.rm = TRUE)

# H1 Label main effect on trust
labCon <- contrast(emmTrust, list(`Label main effect` = c(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5))) %>%
            as.data.frame()

tostTab <- bind_rows(
  runTOST(intCon$estimate, intCon$SE, intCon$df, cfg$sesoi_h3_d, sdTrust,
          "H3 — Label × Transparency interaction on trust"),
  runTOST(labCon$estimate, labCon$SE, labCon$df, cfg$sesoi_h1_d, sdTrust,
          "H1 — Label main effect on trust")
)
knitr::kable(tostTab, caption = "Table 23. TOST equivalence tests on null primaries (H3 interaction, H1 main effect)")
```

```{r fig-equivalence, fig.width=7, fig.height=3, fig.cap="Equivalence intervals against SESOI bounds"}

equivDF <- tostTab %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = factor(c("H3 — Label × Transparency", "H1 — Label main effect"),
                    levels = c("H3 — Label × Transparency", "H1 — Label main effect")),
    ynum = as.numeric(Effect),
    supported = equivalence == "Supported"
  )

xLim <- max(abs(c(equivDF$CI90_low, equivDF$CI90_high, equivDF$bound))) * 1.15

ggplot(equivDF) +

                label = sprintf("equivalence bound \u00b1%.2f", bound)),
            colour = accentCol, size = 2.8, vjust = 0) +
  # plain 90% CI, one weight, coloured by verdict

                orientation = "y", width = 0, linewidth = 2.6) +

  # estimate value at right
```

# 20. Exclusion-based sensitivity (alternative to covariate adjustment)

The pre-registered strategy uses suspicion / off-script as covariates. For transparency, this section reports what would happen under the exclusion strategy the pre-registration rejects, so the reader can confirm the substantive conclusion is invariant to that choice.

```{r sensitivity}
fitTrustSens <- function(d, label) {
  m <- tryCatch(aov(trustMayer ~ Label * Transparency, data = d),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m) || nrow(d) < 8) return(tibble(Sample = label, n = nrow(d)))
  if (any(is.na(coef(m)))) return(tibble(Sample = label, n = nrow(d)))
  a <- car::Anova(m, type = 3)
  e <- effectsize::eta_squared(m, partial = TRUE)
  tibble(Sample = label, n = nrow(d),
         F_Label = a$`F value`[2], p_Label = a$`Pr(>F)`[2],
         eta2_Label = e$Eta2_partial[1],
         F_Trans = a$`F value`[3], p_Trans = a$`Pr(>F)`[3],
         eta2_Trans = e$Eta2_partial[2],
         F_Inter = a$`F value`[4], p_Inter = a$`Pr(>F)`[4],
         eta2_Inter = e$Eta2_partial[3])
}

offScriptUsable <- "offScriptPct" %in% names(data) &&
                   sum(!is.na(data$offScriptPct)) >= cfg$covariate_min_nonNA

# Additional sensitivity: stall rate as covariate
fitTrustSensStall <- function(d, label) {
  m <- tryCatch(aov(trustMayer ~ Label * Transparency + stallRate, data = d),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m) || nrow(d) < 8) return(tibble(Sample = label, n = nrow(d)))
  if (any(is.na(coef(m)))) return(tibble(Sample = label, n = nrow(d)))
  a <- car::Anova(m, type = 3)
  e <- effectsize::eta_squared(m, partial = TRUE)
  tibble(Sample = label, n = nrow(d),
         F_Label = a$`F value`[2], p_Label = a$`Pr(>F)`[2],
         eta2_Label = e$Eta2_partial[1],
         F_Trans = a$`F value`[3], p_Trans = a$`Pr(>F)`[3],
         eta2_Trans = e$Eta2_partial[2],
         F_Inter = a$`F value`[4], p_Inter = a$`Pr(>F)`[4],
         eta2_Inter = e$Eta2_partial[3])
}

# Education as ordinal covariate (exploratory)
data$educOrd <- case_when(data$education == "Bachelor's degree" ~ 1L,
  data$education == "Master's degree" ~ 2L,
  data$education == "Doctoral degree" ~ 3L,
  .default = NA_integer_)

sensRows <- list(
  fitTrustSens(data, "Full (covariate-adjusted is primary)"),
  if (var(data$stallRate, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
    fitTrustSensStall(data[!is.na(data$stallRate), ],
                      "Full + stallRate covariate")
  else
    tibble(Sample = "Full + stallRate covariate (zero variance — skipped)", n = sum(!is.na(data$stallRate))),
  fitTrustSens(data %>% filter(suspicion < cfg$susp_exclusion_cutoff),
               sprintf("Excl. suspicious (susp >= %d)", cfg$susp_exclusion_cutoff))
)
if (offScriptUsable) {
  sensRows <- c(sensRows, list(
    fitTrustSens(data %>% filter(offScriptPct < cfg$offscript_exclusion_cutoff),
                 sprintf("Excl. off-script (>= %.0f%%)", cfg$offscript_exclusion_cutoff * 100)),
    fitTrustSens(data %>% filter(suspicion < cfg$susp_exclusion_cutoff,
                                 offScriptPct < cfg$offscript_exclusion_cutoff),
                 "Both excluded")
  ))
} else {
  cat("Note: off-script exclusion regimes skipped — offScriptPct not coded for this dataset.\n")
}
sensTab <- bind_rows(sensRows)
knitr::kable(roundDF(sensTab, 3),
             caption = "Table 24. Trust ANOVA across alternative exclusion regimes (Type-III SS, no covariates)")
```

# 21. Exploratory — fairness-belief revision (pre vs post)

The protocol captures `preFairSplit` (introduction), `chatFairSplit` (mid-negotiation) and `postFairSplit` (post-survey). If AI labelling shifts perceived fair-equity norms — the policy concern Article 50 indirectly speaks to — we should see condition differences in *belief revision*, not only in trust ratings.

```{r belief-revision}
beliefDF <- data %>%
  select(participantCode, Label, Transparency,
         preFairSplit, chatFairSplit, postFairSplit) %>%
  mutate(deltaPrePost = postFairSplit - preFairSplit,
         deltaPreChat = chatFairSplit - preFairSplit)

if (sum(!is.na(beliefDF$deltaPrePost)) > 30) {
  modBelief <- aov(addCovariates(deltaPrePost ~ Label * Transparency, data),
                   data = data %>% mutate(deltaPrePost = beliefDF$deltaPrePost))
  print(tidyAnova3(modBelief))

  beliefSummary <- beliefDF %>%
    group_by(Label, Transparency) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(!is.na(deltaPrePost)),
              preM    = mean(preFairSplit,  na.rm = TRUE),
              postM   = mean(postFairSplit, na.rm = TRUE),
              deltaM  = mean(deltaPrePost,  na.rm = TRUE),
              deltaSD = sd(deltaPrePost,    na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
  print(knitr::kable(roundDF(beliefSummary),
               caption = "Table 25. Pre→post fairness-belief revision by cell"))
} else {
  cat("Belief-revision skipped — pre/post fairness items too sparse in this export.\n")
}
```
## 21a. Perceived exploitation — pre-registered fairness-perception measure
```{r perceived-exploit}
# Pre-registered item: "To what extent do you think the representative tried
# to take advantage of you?" (1-5). Bears on the Article 50 concern that
# labelling a counterpart 'AI' changes whether people feel preyed upon.

modExploit  <- aov(addCovariates(perceivedExploit ~ Label * Transparency, data),
                   data = data)
exploitTab  <- tidyAnova3(modExploit)
knitr::kable(roundDF(exploitTab, 3),
             caption = "Table 26. Perceived exploitation (1-5) — Type-III SS, covariate-adjusted")

emmExploit <- emmeans(modExploit, ~ Label * Transparency)
print(emmExploit)

gExploit <- effectsize::hedges_g(perceivedExploit ~ Label, data = data)
cat(sprintf("\nLabel main effect on perceived exploitation: Hedges' g = %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
            gExploit$Hedges_g, gExploit$CI_low, gExploit$CI_high))

# Does perceived exploitation track suspicion, the one live association?
# (Parallels the suspicion -> trust finding.)
exploitSuspCor <- cor.test(data$perceivedExploit, data$suspicion,
                           use = "complete.obs")
cat(sprintf(
  "Perceived exploitation vs suspicion: r = %.2f [%.2f, %.2f], p %s (n = %d)\n",
  exploitSuspCor$estimate,
  exploitSuspCor$conf.int[1], exploitSuspCor$conf.int[2],
  ifelse(exploitSuspCor$p.value < .001, "< .001",
         sprintf("= %.3f", exploitSuspCor$p.value)),
  sum(!is.na(data$perceivedExploit) & !is.na(data$suspicion))))
```


```{r belief-revision-plot, fig.height = 4.8}
if (sum(!is.na(beliefDF$deltaPrePost)) > 30) {
  longBelief <- beliefDF %>%
    select(participantCode, Label, Transparency, preFairSplit, postFairSplit) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(preFairSplit, postFairSplit),
                 names_to = "stage", values_to = "fairSplit") %>%
    mutate(stage = factor(stage,
                          levels = c("preFairSplit","postFairSplit"),
                          labels = c("Pre","Post")))

   print(
  ggplot(longBelief %>% drop_na(fairSplit),
         aes(stage, fairSplit, group = participantCode)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.10, colour = pathCol) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = Label, colour = Label), fun = mean,
                 geom = "line", linewidth = 1.3) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = Label, colour = Label), fun = mean,
                 geom = "point", size = 4, shape = 18) +
    facet_wrap(~ Transparency) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Human = accentCol, AI = hlCol)) +
    labs(x = "Survey stage", y = "Stated fair equity share (%)",
         title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
  )
  figText(
    "Fairness-belief revision from pre- to post-negotiation",
    "Stated fair equity share before and after, by condition")
}
```

## 21b. Exploratory — demographic moderators and predictors of suspicion

```{r education-moderator}
# Gender as moderator (exploratory)
# Binary only — "Other" and "Prefer not to say" have insufficient n for interaction
data$genderBin <- case_when(data$gender == "Female" ~ 0L,
  data$gender == "Male" ~ 1L,
  .default = NA_integer_)

if (sum(!is.na(data$genderBin)) > 50) {
  modGender <- aov(trustMayer ~ Label * Transparency * genderBin, data = data)
  genderTab <- tidyAnova3(modGender)
  print(knitr::kable(roundDF(genderTab, 3),
               caption = "Exploratory — Gender as moderator of trust (Type-III SS)"))

  cat("\nSuspicion by gender and Label:\n")
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(genderBin), !is.na(suspicion)) %>%
    group_by(Label, gender) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), suspM = mean(suspicion, na.rm = TRUE),
              trustM = mean(trustMayer, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("Gender moderator skipped — insufficient non-missing values.\n")
}

# Who detects AI? Predictors of suspicion (exploratory)
if (sum(!is.na(data$suspicion) & !is.na(data$genderBin) & !is.na(data$educOrd)) > 50) {
  modSusp <- lm(suspicion ~ Label + genderBin + educOrd + aiFamiliarity, data = data)
  cat("\nPredictors of suspicion (controlling for Label):\n")
  print(knitr::kable(roundDF(broom::tidy(modSusp, conf.int = TRUE), 3),
                     caption = "Exploratory — Who detects AI? Predictors of suspicion"))
} else {
  cat("Suspicion predictor model skipped — insufficient data.\n")
}

# Education as moderator (exploratory)
if (sum(!is.na(data$educOrd)) > 50) {
  modEduc <- aov(trustMayer ~ Label * Transparency * educOrd, data = data)
  educTab <- tidyAnova3(modEduc)
  print(knitr::kable(roundDF(educTab, 3),
               caption = "Exploratory — Education as moderator of trust (Type-III SS)"))

  cat("\nTrust by education level:\n")
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(educOrd)) %>%
    group_by(Label, education) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), trustM = mean(trustMayer, na.rm = TRUE),
              trustSD = sd(trustMayer, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("Education moderator skipped — insufficient non-missing values.\n")
}
```


## 21c. Exploratory — Suspicion-reason thematic analysis

Pre-registered inductive coding of free-text suspicion reasons, cross-tabulated with condition and detection accuracy.

```{r suspicion-sheet-export}
# Stage 1: export the coding sheet from the already-filtered `data`
# Uses the same `data` object as every other analysis, so the coded sample is
# identical to the analytical sample.

cueCols <- c("cue_timing", "cue_language_precision", "cue_emotional_variation",
             "cue_negotiation_rationality", "cue_communication_style",
             "cue_holistic")

codingSheet <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(suspicionReason) & str_trim(suspicionReason) != "") %>%
  transmute(
    row_id            = row_number(),
    participant       = participantCode,
    label_condition   = as.character(Label),
    transparency      = as.character(Transparency),
    suspicion_score   = suspicion,                        # 1–6 (pre-registered coding)
    detection_correct = case_when(                        # leaned the right way for the condition
      is.na(suspicion)                  ~ NA_real_,
      Label == "Human" & suspicion <= 3 ~ 1,
      Label == "AI"    & suspicion >= 4 ~ 1,
      TRUE                              ~ 0),
    suspicion_reason  = str_squish(suspicionReason)        # collapse internal whitespace/newlines
  )
# empty cue columns for the coder — enter 1 if the cue is present, else blank
for (cc in cueCols) codingSheet[[cc]] <- NA_integer_
codingSheet$notes <- NA_character_

# write once; never overwrite a hand-coded sheet on a re-knit
if (!file.exists("suspicion_coding_sheet.csv")) {
  write_csv(codingSheet, "suspicion_coding_sheet.csv", na = "")
  cat(sprintf("Coding sheet exported: %d responses (%s).\n",
              nrow(codingSheet), "suspicion_coding_sheet.csv"))
} else {
  cat("Coding sheet already present — not overwritten.\n")
}
cat(sprintf("  By condition: Human = %d, AI = %d\n",
            sum(codingSheet$label_condition == "Human"),
            sum(codingSheet$label_condition == "AI")))
```

```{r suspicion-thematic-analysis}
# Stage 2: analyse the coded sheet
# Runs only once the hand-coded file exists. Until then, it stops here with a
# note, so the document knits cleanly at every stage.

CODED <- "suspicion_coding_sheet_CODED.csv"

if (!file.exists(CODED)) {
  cat(strrep("-", 68), "\n")
  cat("Suspicion-reason coding sheet EXPORTED for inductive coding.\n\n")
  cat("Before this analysis can run:\n")
  cat("  1. Open  suspicion_coding_sheet.csv\n")
  cat("  2. Code the six cue_* columns by hand against the codebook\n")
  cat("     (1 = cue present, blank = absent; multi-label — a response may\n")
  cat("      score several cues).\n")
  cat("  3. Save as  suspicion_coding_sheet_CODED.csv  (same folder).\n")
  cat("  4. Re-knit — this block will then produce the cross-tabs.\n\n")
  cat(strrep("-", 68), "\n")

} else {

  coded <- read_csv(CODED, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cueCols), ~ replace_na(as.integer(.), 0L)))

  cat(sprintf("Coded responses: %d\n\n", nrow(coded)))

  # flag any response coded with no cue at all (should be rare)
  noCue <- coded %>% filter(rowSums(across(all_of(cueCols))) == 0)
  if (nrow(noCue) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("Note: %d response(s) carry no cue code (row_id: %s).\n\n",
                nrow(noCue), paste(noCue$row_id, collapse = ", ")))

  ## Overall cue frequency
  freqTab <- coded %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(cueCols), sum)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Cue", values_to = "n") %>%
    mutate(`%` = round(100 * n / nrow(coded), 1)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  print(knitr::kable(freqTab,
    caption = "Table 27. Cue frequency across all suspicion reasons"))

  ## Cue x Condition (chi-square per cue)
  byCond <- map_dfr(cueCols, function(cue) {
    tab <- table(coded$label_condition, coded[[cue]])
    if (ncol(tab) < 2) return(tibble(Cue = cue, Human_pct = NA, AI_pct = NA,
                                     chi2 = NA, p = NA))
    tt <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE))
    pr <- prop.table(tab, 1)[, "1"] * 100
    tibble(Cue = cue,
           Human_pct = round(pr[["Human"]], 1),
           AI_pct    = round(pr[["AI"]], 1),
           chi2 = round(unname(tt$statistic), 2),
           p    = round(tt$p.value, 3))
  }) %>% mutate(p_holm = round(p.adjust(p, method = "holm"), 3))
  print(knitr::kable(byCond,
    caption = "Table 28. Cue citation by label condition (Holm-corrected across the six cues)"))

  ## Cue x Detection accuracy (chi-square per cue)
  byDetect <- map_dfr(cueCols, function(cue) {
    sub <- coded %>% filter(!is.na(detection_correct))
    tab <- table(sub$detection_correct, sub[[cue]])
    if (ncol(tab) < 2 || nrow(tab) < 2)
      return(tibble(Cue = cue, Incorrect_pct = NA, Correct_pct = NA,
                    chi2 = NA, p = NA))
    tt <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE))
    pr <- prop.table(tab, 1)[, "1"] * 100
    tibble(Cue = cue,
           Incorrect_pct = round(pr[["0"]], 1),
           Correct_pct   = round(pr[["1"]], 1),
           chi2 = round(unname(tt$statistic), 2),
           p    = round(tt$p.value, 3))
  })
  print(knitr::kable(byDetect,
    caption = "Table 29. Cue citation by detection accuracy"))

  ## --- Richness: cues per response ---
  coded <- coded %>% mutate(n_cues = rowSums(across(all_of(cueCols))))
  cat(sprintf("\nMean cues per response: %.2f (range %d–%d)\n",
              mean(coded$n_cues), min(coded$n_cues), max(coded$n_cues)))

  ## Figure: cue frequency by condition
  cueLabels <- c(cue_timing = "Response timing",
                 cue_language_precision = "Language precision",
                 cue_emotional_variation = "Emotional variation",
                 cue_negotiation_rationality = "Negotiation reasoning",
                 cue_communication_style = "Communication style",
                 cue_holistic = "Holistic impression")
  plotDF <- coded %>%
    select(label_condition, all_of(cueCols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-label_condition, names_to = "cue", values_to = "present") %>%
    group_by(label_condition, cue) %>%
    summarise(pct = 100 * mean(present), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cue = recode(cue, !!!cueLabels))

  print(
    ggplot(plotDF, aes(reorder(cue, pct), pct, fill = label_condition)) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Human = accentCol, AI = hlCol)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "% of responses citing the cue",
           fill = "Label", title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
  )

  figText(
    "Detection cues cited by condition",
    "Percentage of suspicion reasons invoking each cue category")
}
```


# 22. Exploratory — chat sentiment by Label (supplementary only)
# NOTE: Bing lexicon is a poor fit for negotiation language — "reject" and
# "counter" code as negative, inflating negativity across all conditions.
# Reported as supplementary; standard lexicons misclassify negotiation terms, so it is not interpreted substantively.

```{r chat-sentiment, fig.height = 5}
parseChat <- function(jsonStr, pid) {
  if (is.na(jsonStr) || jsonStr == "") return(NULL)
  msgs <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(jsonStr), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(msgs) || !is.data.frame(msgs)) return(NULL)
  msgs %>% filter(sender == cfg$chat_sender_participant) %>%
           transmute(participantCode = pid, text = text)
}

# fall back to the anonymised integer key so messages tag to real participants.
if (!any(!is.na(data$participantCode) & data$participantCode != ""))
  data$participantCode <- as.character(data$participant_id)
chatTokens <- map2_dfr(data$chatLog, data$participantCode, parseChat) %>%
  tidytext::unnest_tokens(word, text)

if (nrow(chatTokens) > 0) {
  bing <- tidytext::get_sentiments("bing")
  sentByPID <- chatTokens %>%
    inner_join(bing, by = "word") %>%
    count(participantCode, sentiment) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sentiment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(sentScore = positive - negative,
           totalSent = positive + negative)

  chatStats <- chatTokens %>%
    count(participantCode, name = "nWords") %>%
    left_join(sentByPID, by = "participantCode") %>%
    mutate(across(c(positive, negative, sentScore, totalSent),
                  \(x) replace_na(x, 0)),
           sentScoreNorm = sentScore / pmax(nWords, 1))

  chatStats$participantCode <- as.character(chatStats$participantCode)
data$participantCode      <- as.character(data$participantCode)
dataChat <- data %>% left_join(chatStats, by = "participantCode")
  sentTest <- t.test(sentScoreNorm ~ Label, data = dataChat)
  print(sentTest)

  print(
  ggplot(dataChat %>% filter(!is.na(sentScoreNorm)),
         aes(Label, sentScoreNorm, fill = Label)) +
    ggdist::stat_halfeye(adjust = 0.6, width = 0.6, .width = 0,
                         justification = -0.20, point_colour = NA) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.14, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.04, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Human = accentCol, AI = hlCol)) +
    labs(x = "Label condition", y = "Sentiment score (positive − negative) / words",
         title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  )
  figText(
    "Participant chat sentiment by Label condition",
    "Net sentiment of participants' own messages")
} else {
  cat("Sentiment skipped — no chat tokens parsed.\n")
}
```

# 23. Hypothesis summary table & forest plot

## 23a. Pre-registered hypothesis tests

```{r summary-hypotheses}
# Holm-Bonferroni correction across the 4 confirmatory tests (H1, H2a, H2b, H3)
# H4 and H5 are pre-registered as exploratory — not included in the correction family.
confirmatory_p <- c(
  trustTab$p[trustTab$term == "Label"],
  openTab$p[openTab$term == "Transparency"],
  concessionTab$p[concessionTab$term == "Transparency"],
  trustTab$p[trustTab$term == "Label:Transparency"]
)
holm_p <- p.adjust(confirmatory_p, method = "holm")

hypTab <- tibble(
  Hypothesis = c(
    "H1 — AI label reduces trust",
    "H2a — Transparency raises opening demand",
    "H2b — Transparency reduces concession",
    "H3 — Label × Transparency on trust",
    "H4 (exploratory) — AI label increases disagreement",
    "H5 (exploratory) — Subscale profile discriminates mechanisms"
  ),
  Test = c(
    "2×2 ANOVA, main effect of Label",
    "2×2 ANOVA, main effect of Transparency on opening demand",
    "2×2 ANOVA, main effect of Transparency on concession",
    "2×2 ANOVA, Label × Transparency interaction on trust",
    "Logistic regression, main effect of Label",
    "MANOVA on (competence, benevolence, predictability) + profile-distance"
  ),
  Statistic = c(
    sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f",
            trustTab$df[trustTab$term == "Label"],
            modTrust$df.residual,
            trustTab$F[trustTab$term == "Label"]),
    sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f",
            openTab$df[openTab$term == "Transparency"],
            modOpen$df.residual,
            openTab$F[openTab$term == "Transparency"]),
    sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f",
            concessionTab$df[concessionTab$term == "Transparency"],
            modConcession$df.residual,
            concessionTab$F[concessionTab$term == "Transparency"]),
    sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f",
            trustTab$df[trustTab$term == "Label:Transparency"],
            modTrust$df.residual,
            trustTab$F[trustTab$term == "Label:Transparency"]),
    sprintf("OR = %.2f",
            exp(-2 * broom::tidy(modAgree)$estimate[
                       broom::tidy(modAgree)$term == "Label1"])),
    "see Tables 19 + MANOVA output (§14)"
  ),
  p = c(
    formatP(trustTab$p[trustTab$term == "Label"]),
    formatP(openTab$p[openTab$term == "Transparency"]),
    formatP(concessionTab$p[concessionTab$term == "Transparency"]),
    formatP(trustTab$p[trustTab$term == "Label:Transparency"]),
    formatP(broom::tidy(modAgree)$p.value[broom::tidy(modAgree)$term == "Label1"]),
    "—"
  ),
  p_holm = c(formatP(holm_p[1]), formatP(holm_p[2]),
             formatP(holm_p[3]), formatP(holm_p[4]),
             "—", "—"),
  EffectSize = c(
    sprintf("η²p = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
            trustTab$eta2p[trustTab$term == "Label"],
            trustTab$ci_lo[trustTab$term == "Label"],
            trustTab$ci_hi[trustTab$term == "Label"]),
    sprintf("η²p = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
            openTab$eta2p[openTab$term == "Transparency"],
            openTab$ci_lo[openTab$term == "Transparency"],
            openTab$ci_hi[openTab$term == "Transparency"]),
    sprintf("η²p = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
            concessionTab$eta2p[concessionTab$term == "Transparency"],
            concessionTab$ci_lo[concessionTab$term == "Transparency"],
            concessionTab$ci_hi[concessionTab$term == "Transparency"]),
    sprintf("η²p = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
            trustTab$eta2p[trustTab$term == "Label:Transparency"],
            trustTab$ci_lo[trustTab$term == "Label:Transparency"],
            trustTab$ci_hi[trustTab$term == "Label:Transparency"]),
    "OR + 95% CI in Table 18",
    "—"
  )
)
knitr::kable(hypTab,
             caption = "Table 30. Pre-registered hypothesis tests — primary results")
```

## 23b. Forest plot of partial η² for the primary trust + demand effects

The forest plot reads from the trust ANOVA for H1 and H3, and from the demand ANOVAs (opening and concession) for H2a and H2b, following the hypothesis structure.

```{r forest, fig.height = 5}
forestDF <- bind_rows(
  trustTab %>%
    filter(term %in% c("Label","Transparency","Label:Transparency")) %>%
    transmute(Effect = case_when(
      term == "Label"              ~ "H1 — Label → Trust",
      term == "Transparency"       ~ "(supplementary) Transparency → Trust",
      term == "Label:Transparency" ~ "H3 — Label × Transparency → Trust"),
      est = eta2p, low = ci_lo, upp = ci_hi),
  openTab %>%
    filter(term == "Transparency") %>%
    transmute(Effect = "H2a — Transparency → Opening demand",
              est = eta2p, low = ci_lo, upp = ci_hi),
  concessionTab %>%
    filter(term == "Transparency") %>%
    transmute(Effect = "H2b — Transparency → Concession",
              est = eta2p, low = ci_lo, upp = ci_hi)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Effect)) %>%
  mutate(Effect = factor(Effect, levels = c(
    "H1 — Label → Trust",
    "H2a — Transparency → Opening demand",
    "H2b — Transparency → Concession",
    "H3 — Label × Transparency → Trust",
    "(supplementary) Transparency → Trust"
  )))
xMax    <- max(0.10, max(forestDF$est, na.rm = TRUE) * 3, na.rm = TRUE)
xMax    <- min(xMax, 0.30)
clipped <- any(forestDF$upp > xMax, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(forestDF, aes(est, Effect)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 0.01,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#F2F3F4", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.01, xmax = 0.06,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#ABEBC6", alpha = 0.15) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.06, xmax = 0.14,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#F9E79F", alpha = 0.15) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.14, xmax = xMax,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#F5B7B1", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = mainCol, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = pmax(low, 0), xmax = pmin(upp, xMax)),
                orientation = "y", width = 0, linewidth = 3, colour = accentCol, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 18, colour = hlCol) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", est), x = pmin(upp, xMax)),
            hjust = -0.3, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", colour = mainCol) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Partial eta-squared (95% CI)",
    limits = c(0, xMax),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
    sec.axis = dup_axis(
      breaks = c(0.005, 0.035, 0.10, 0.22),
      labels = c("negligible", "small", "medium", "large"),
      name   = NULL
    )
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL,
       caption  = if (clipped)
                    sprintf("Note: x-axis truncated at %.2f; some CIs extend further.", xMax)
                  else NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 10, colour = mainCol, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x.top   = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9, colour = subtleCol),
        axis.ticks.x.top  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y      = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#EEEEEE", linewidth = 0.3))

figText(
  "Effect sizes for the primary outcomes",
  "Partial eta-squared with 95% confidence intervals, in hypothesis order")
```
